utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Did we talk about that already?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, this weekend! I'm bringing my toaster and toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This weekend? Oh right, I think I was supposed to bring something... maybe my old lamp or something? What time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, are you ready to help with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Mara! I've got the location set—the Hendersons' place is ready for us to work on the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Opal! Thanks for helping secure the Hendersons' place—it'll be great to get that playground fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm planning to check the old Henderson place for any tools we can use. Want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I'm short on time, but let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do, I'll let you know if I find anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Dane, I just heard from Opal that the repair drive is on for Saturday. I'll let Bo know he can bring his tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday, got it. And we're meeting at Gus's place, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that's what Opal said—Gus's place. I'll pass that along to Bo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Exactly, Noah. We need to know what we have before we can start fixing anything. Let's get organized first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we sure this repair drive is still on? I heard it got postponed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven't heard anything about a postponement. I've been gathering supplies for it, so as far as I know, it's still happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard! I've got all my tools prepped and ready to go in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Awesome, see you Saturday then! They're taking anything with a plug, you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi there! I'm organizing a repair drive for the playground this Saturday at 10 am. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Faye! I've already got that Saturday blocked off for the repair drive. Happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Sam! Thanks for your support. We'll meet at the playground at 10, and I'll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So Pia, do we have a firm start time for this repair drive? I like to have my day mapped out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I wish I had a solid answer, Eli. I'm still waiting to hear if the drive is even happening—and who's bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, we can't just wait around forever. Can we get Quinn on the line and sort this out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I think I forgot—what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's to fix broken household items at the community center. Mara's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the community center! I think I have a broken toaster somewhere. I'll try to dig it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I was wondering about that too. Do you know if they fix small kitchen appliances like my old blender?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard from Leo it's for fixing broken items, so your blender should be fine.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know, thanks Nell.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive: Saturday, 10am. Bring broken stuff, we fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo! I'll get a sign-up sheet going so we know what everyone's bringing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I'll bring extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rosa, are you going to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh, Sunday? Good to know. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, no worries. I'm all set to help—just waiting on Quinn for a timeline on when we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it. So Quinn's the one with the schedule? Let me know if there's anything I can grab in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm pretty sure I saw a notice online saying it was pushed back. Did you check the community board?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I did check the community board this morning, and it still said Saturday at 9 a.m. at the playground. Maybe the online notice was outdated.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure the board gets updated regularly? I wouldn't put it past them to leave old notices up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Jules, did you get the car fixed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, but I'm planning to bring it to the repair drive this Saturday—maybe they can help!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what parts you'll need? I might have some spares.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, are you free this Saturday to help out at the tool repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. Got my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, glad you're on board! We'll start around 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds like a great idea! I have a broken lamp I've been meaning to fix. Can I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That depends—do we have someone who can handle electrical repairs? I'm still waiting to hear who's bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hmm, I'm not sure about electrical stuff. Maybe we can ask around and see who knows how to fix lamps?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sorry, Mara, I don't think I can this weekend. I've got some personal things to take care of.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I thought we were on for Saturday? I've got an hour.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm really sorry, Bo, but I can't make it this Saturday. I hope you understand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Gus, do you know what items people are bringing to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven't heard the full list yet, but I'm expecting everything from toasters to bikes. My workbench is ready!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So toasters and bikes—anything else you've heard about, or is that the gist of it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 am—we're fixing the playground swings and slide. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Saturday? Let me check what tools we have for playground repairs before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, take your time! Let me know what you find—we've got some basic tools here too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're collecting old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Tess! Just a heads-up though, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! I had Saturday marked down, but I'll be there Sunday with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I just told Bo he can bring his tools on Saturday. Are you thinking of stopping by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, I've got a rusty saw and a broken toaster—I'll bring them along Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, the more the merrier! I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, we're organizing a repair drive for the school playground this Saturday at 10. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help. Also, do you have a sign-up sheet for what items they'll fix? I was thinking of bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great idea! I'll start a sign-up sheet right now. What's the blender model, so we can add it to the list?
